boundary_contract.periodic_axes: X/Y/Z explicit fragment relocation; no minimum image
boundary_contract.same_source_rule: relocated fragments are independent; same-source fragment pairs are excluded
boundary_contract.A_geometry: reuse D-mode centerline cuts and mapped flat-cylinder fragments
boundary_contract.B_geometry: exact ball-cell intersections mapped to the base box
boundary_contract.limitation: A uses centerline cuts: radius-side overflow and oblique Boolean cut faces are not reconstructed. B spherical fragments use exact convex intersections.
